title: FX canvas layout report (fx-layout-report-v1)
description: Where the viewer places a run's or a saved plan's steps (layout.md §6.11): every slot's cell and every member's order, served at the scoped `api/layout` route. The browser places its own cards in these cells and never computes one. Ship A serves automatic cells only; `file`, `revision` and `diagnostics` stay empty until the layout file ships.

file.description: The derived project-relative POSIX path of the layout file, or null when no location is known.

revision.description: The file digest (identity.md §2) of the layout file bytes read, or null when nothing was read.

cursor.description: For a run, the observation cursor of the record prefix the report reflects; null for a plan.

cells.description: Every slot's address mapped to its cell in its container (layout.md §4), container by container from the root. A container's frames share its cells, so an address is an unambiguous key.

order.description: Every member, instance ids and scope ids, in order key (layout.md §4 rule 4). Only the relative order of one slot's members is meaningful.
